base_sweep.purpose: Full mod/file/dependency/event/team/comment sweep across all BG3 mods on mod.io
base_sweep.known_defect: Comment sub-resource fetched with no _offset/_limit pagination loop -- a single default-page (limit=100) request per mod, so any mod with more than ~100 comments was silently truncated

deep_refresh.purpose: Re-fetch full comment threads for mods the base sweep truncated

auth.method: Cloudflare bot-management session cookies (__cf_bm, __cflb, _cfuvid), minted by one headless-Chromium (Playwright) page load of https://mod.io/g/baldursgate3, reused across a requests.Session() for all subsequent HTTP calls
auth.note: This is a different, undocumented endpoint from the base sweep's api_key-based host; it does not require an api_key at all.

params._offset: starts at 0, incremented by len(batch) each call

pagination.stop_condition: loop ends when the returned batch is empty OR offset >= response's result_total field

mod_selection_rule.description: A mod qualifies for deep-refresh if its row count in modio_comments_fullsweep.jsonl (the base sweep's comment file) is >= 100
mod_selection_rule.rationale: The base sweep made one unpaginated request per mod at the API's default page size (100). Any mod at/above that count is provably truncated; any mod below it is provably complete, since a single default-size page cannot be truncated when the true total is under the page size.

outcome.displayed_vs_captured: For all 115 mods, captured count equals mod.io's own result_total field by construction of the pagination stop condition -- the loop cannot exit early. Independently spot-checked against the live page UI for mod_id 5714166 (DTO: Otherworldly Archetypes): page displayed 'Discussion 129', captured count 129, exact match.

merge.logic: modio_comments_fullsweep.jsonl rows for the 115 refreshed mod_ids are dropped and replaced by modio_comments_deep_refresh.jsonl rows; all remaining rows deduplicated by comment `id`
merge.note: v1.0 of this script (run 2026-07-21T12:31:00-05:00) did not deduplicate and is superseded; its output is not retained.

deduplication.key: comment `id` (globally unique per mod.io, independent of mod_id)
deduplication.rule: Keep the first occurrence per id in file-processing order (untouched-old rows processed before new-refresh rows); drop subsequent rows sharing the same id
deduplication.duplicate_count_breakdown: Of the original 184 duplicate-id groups in modio_comments_fullsweep.jsonl: 56 belonged to mods among the 115 refreshed, so those old rows (dupes included) were already discarded wholesale during the mod-replacement step, before dedup ran. The remaining 128 groups belonged to untouched mods and were caught and dropped by the id-based dedup.
deduplication.root_cause: The base sweep's resume/retry logic was not idempotent at the comment level, causing some comments to be written twice across separate script invocations. Sampled duplicate pairs (e.g. ids 1543954, 1531957) were verified byte-identical across every field (content, timestamp, karma, user) -- confirming simple repeated writes, not conflicting revisions.
deduplication.verification_post_fix: 0 duplicate ids remain in modio_comments_merged.jsonl (76,043 rows, 76,043 unique ids)

schema_cohorts.note: The merged file mixes rows from two different mod.io hosts/endpoints with slightly different field sets. Both are the same underlying comment data; the difference is purely which endpoint's response shape was captured.

cohort_A_old_untouched.source: modio_comments_fullsweep.jsonl (bg3_scraper.py, g-6715.modapi.io host, api_key auth) -- SAME original sweep as cohort B's source file, not a separate/different scraper run
cohort_A_old_untouched.caveat: These 4,246 mods' totals were NOT independently re-verified against mod.io's live result_total -- completeness is inferred from the mod-selection-rule rationale above (single default-100 page, count < 100 observed), not empirically confirmed per mod. A verification-only pass (result_total lookup, no content re-fetch) would take ~4,246 lightweight requests to close this gap.

cohort_B_deep_refresh.source: modio_comments_deep_refresh.jsonl (modio_deep_comments.py, mod.io/v1 web host, cookie auth)

base_sweep_mod_coverage.note: Base sweep's internal progress checkpoint (modio_progress.json result_total field) matches the row count of modio_mods_full_sweep.jsonl exactly (8145 = 8145), indicating the metadata sweep completed with no dropped mods in its final state. Per-mod fail/skip counts during earlier retries within that sweep were not separately logged, so historical retry-level detail (as opposed to final-state completeness) is not available.
